missions.name: Basic Training
missions.premise: Four target drones in the outer belt. Range control wants your gunnery sign-off before the fleet moves.
missions.primary: Destroy all four target drone flights.
missions.secondary: Finish with both starting fighter squadrons intact.
missions.bonus: Clear the range before the second time call.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Four drone flights on the range. No live warheads on their side. Clear them and we can sign your ticket.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Take them one pair at a time, Commander. My first checkout, I let number four drift behind an asteroid and spent twenty minutes chasing it.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Hang on. I'm picking up a distress call on the merchant channel. Ore carrier out of Morrow Gate says someone's shooting at her.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Finish the exercise, Lieutenant. The sector picket can handle Morrow Gate.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: That is the sector picket, sir. They're the ones calling.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: That'll do. Gunnery's signed off. Form up on the jump buoy for Core Outskirts, ten minutes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Short graduation. I'll tell the pilots to top off their tanks.

missions.name: Core Outskirts
missions.premise: Three rebel bomber flights are making a run on the Core Outskirts freight station.
missions.secondary: Keep the bombers off the station docking ring.
missions.bonus: Log the lead bomber's transponder serial.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Three bomber groups are coming in on the freight ring. They've already backed traffic up to the buoy. Clear them out.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Station control says they still have loading crews on the outer ring. Let's get out in front of those bombers before they drop.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Hold on. That bomber we just splashed was squawking a Navy yard transponder. Why would rebels be flying with fleet registry tags?

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Transponders get stripped from salvage every week. Send the serial to intelligence and keep your eyes on the rest of them.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I did. Their system kicked the report back as restricted before it even finished sending.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Station's answering again. They lost a cargo shed on the lower ring, but the dock crews made it inside.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Good. Leave the cleanup to the station tugs. We've got a location on Garric Holt.

missions.name: System Patrol
missions.premise: Salvage boss Garric Holt is refitting a heavy cruiser inside an old fleet wreck field.
missions.secondary: Record the signal burst from Holt's bridge.
missions.bonus: Lose no more than one fighter squadron.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Garric Holt has been running raids out of this wreck field for six months. His ship is the big hull in the middle. Put it down.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: He's got three cannon frigates parked out front. Take the fighters wide around the debris so we don't eat their broadsides.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Imperial ships, hold your fire. This is Holt's relay. He's carrying the harbour manifests from the Thessa convoy. Ask your admiral why he's trying to sink them.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Don't answer that channel. Keep firing.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: They just sent a text file over the open band. Forty kilobytes. That's not a jamming script.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Holt's ship is breaking up. That file finished coming through right before his bridge went dark. I saved it to the log.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Wipe it from the log, Lieutenant. We're moving on Holt's rock base before the rest of his crew scatters.

missions.name: Pirate Base
missions.premise: Holt's crews have a rock anchorage in the belt where they strip salvaged hulls and store their cargo manifests.
missions.secondary: Pull the shipping logs from the rock dock.
missions.bonus: Keep a frigate alive to tow the dock drives.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Holt's anchorage is inside the large asteroid ahead. One flak frigate and four fighter flights on guard. Go in before they can pull their drives.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: We've finally got frigates of our own for this one. Let them soak the flak before you send the fighters in.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I'm reading the dock's yard list. These aren't raided merchantmen. They're civilian transports from the Thessa evacuation, logged under Navy salvage contracts.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Leave the yard files for the intelligence team, Lieutenant.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: The transport Meridian is on this list, sir. My brother was on her crew.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: The departure stamps are all here. Command closed the Thessa lane twelve minutes before the convoy reached the checkpoint.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Off the net, Kest. You can bring it to my office when this deployment is over.

missions.name: Military Excursion
missions.premise: Naval Command orders a deep run into rebel territory to recover former transit records director Dr. Leena Sar.
missions.primary: Hold the pickup point for five minutes.
missions.bonus: Bring Dr. Sar's archive drives aboard.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Dr. Leena Sar, formerly of Transit Records, is aboard a rebel courier in this sector. Our boarding shuttle is going in to fetch her. Hold the jump point for five minutes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Two jumps inside their border and only two cannon frigates on screen. Expect company before the timer's up.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, this is Dr. Sar. Call off your boarding team. Nobody kidnapped me. I left the capital when Admiral Vey's office told me to shred the Thessa transit files.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Wait. We were briefed this was a hostage pickup.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: I asked the Inspectorate for a hearing three times. The third time, Vey sent naval police to my apartment.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Get her aboard the shuttle and shut that transmitter off. Now.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Those ships had signed lane clearances from my office. The Navy closed the corridor while they were already in transit and fired on the lead hulls.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: The Meridian was in that group.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Third hull in line. I brought the fire-control docket with me, Lieutenant. Admiral Vey's signature is on the cover sheet.

missions.name: All out war
missions.premise: Rebel commander Nara Sen leads a strike force toward the capital's Crown Relay to broadcast the Thessa fleet recordings.
missions.secondary: Keep the bombers off the station berths.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: A rebel strike group has reached the outer capital station. Their command staff is on that destroyer. Stop them here.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: There are still merchant ships tied up at the passenger ring. I'm calling the harbourmaster to get them undocked.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, this is Commander Nara Sen. Our target is the Crown Relay. We have the gun-camera recordings from Thessa. Stand aside and let the capital hear them.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: She has three bomber squadrons running on a civilian station. Look at your scopes before you listen to her.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: We sent two evacuation notices in the clear. Your port authority locked the berth clamps to keep our bombers off the relay.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: She's telling the truth about the notices, Commander. Both of them are sitting in the harbour log, marked hold by Fleet Command.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: The destroyer's down, and that's the last of the bombers. Wait. Long-range sensors show a larger group already past the outer marker. This was just a diversion.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: All ships, come about for the palace approach.

missions.name: Final Assault
missions.premise: Two rebel destroyers push through the wreck field outside the capital while outbound transports crowd the evacuation lane.
missions.primary: Hold the palace approach for five minutes.
missions.bonus: Screen Transport Three until it clears the buoy.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The outer line has folded. Two rebel destroyers are pushing through the scrap field toward the palace lane. Hold them off for five minutes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Evacuation transports are still climbing out behind us. Yard workers, civilian families, ministry staff, all sharing one outbound lane.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Move your cover to Transport One. The cabinet ministers are on board.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Transport Three has a damaged drive and four hundred dock workers in the hold. If we pull off, those destroyers will range her.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: My clerks are on Transport Three with the original Thessa ledger books, Commander.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: You have a direct order.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: We don't have enough ships to cover both tracks. Tell me which lane we're holding.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Both transports are past the marker, but Sen's command ship has reached the Crown Relay perimeter.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: She outran her own screen to get there. Hit her before she can link to the dish.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Fleet's formed up, Commander. Give the word.

missions.name: Last Hope
missions.premise: Commander Sen's flagship is in range of the Crown Relay. Stop her battle group, then decide what to do with the Thessa files.
missions.secondary: Receive the archive transfer from Sen's bridge.
missions.bonus: Keep at least one capital ship alive.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Sen's flagship is closing on the relay dish. Break her here and the rebellion is finished.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, you have Dr. Sar's files on your bridge. Look at the name on the Thessa order before you open fire.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I checked the registry stamp before we jumped. It's genuine.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Our main engines are out. We won't make the dish. I'm sending the full Thessa recording to your flagship now.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Shut down your comms array. That is an order.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: The file is already in your buffer, Commander. Once her ship goes down, it's the last copy left.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Sen's flagship is down. The Crown Relay is still online, waiting for a command login.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Your command key can put the recording on the relay right now. Or you can lock the file for an internal board, and the public hears nothing.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Lock the archive, Commander. Now.

endings.choice: Broadcast the Thessa record on the relay.
endings.title: Open Broadcast
endings.text: The recording goes out over the Crown Relay twelve minutes before Naval Command cuts power to the dish. By morning, four border squadrons have refused orders and the ministry has recalled Admiral Vey for questioning. Fighting continues in the outer sectors, with the Thessa logs open on every fleet channel.

endings.choice: Lock the archive for a naval inquiry.
endings.title: Closed File
endings.text: The Admiralty announces a decisive victory at the capital. The Crown Relay returns to normal traffic, and the Thessa files are handed to a closed naval board that meets twice and adjourns without a report. By the next quarter, the Ninth is back on border patrol. Kest requests a transfer to a cargo depot on the rim.
